compiled_state.title: Add annotation-rewrite step to migrate-closure-checks.sh (T2/UPDATE)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: UPDATE

## Goal
Extend `plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-closure-checks.sh` (created by S5) with an annotation-rewrite step that prevents orphaned `← Satisfies:` pointers after migration.

Depends on: T1 (530f-f51c-8b48-4a80) — the RED tests must exist first.

## File Impact
- MODIFY `plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-closure-checks.sh`: add annotation-rewrite step after the SC→Closure Checks split

## Implementation Spec

After migrating a parent epic's `## Success Criteria` → `## Closure Checks` split:
1. Collect the set of criterion texts that were moved to `## Closure Checks` (not retained in `## Success Criteria`)
2. Scan ALL child stories of the migrated epic for `← Satisfies: "<text>"` annotations
3. For each annotation where `<text>` matches a moved criterion: rewrite to `← Validates Closure Check: "<text>"`
4. Leave annotations referencing criteria still in `## Success Criteria` unchanged
5. Idempotency: if annotation already reads `← Validates Closure Check:`, skip (no double-rewrite)
6. Emit a per-story log line: `[ANNOTATE] story/<id>: rewrote N annotation(s)` (or `skipped — 0 matches`)

## Acceptance
- T1 test cases pass (GREEN) after this change
- `bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh` exits 0
- DD1, DD2, DD3 from story 4227-e546-e21f-4261 all satisfied
